file_impact.reason: The gap-only loop: attempt selection, the per-criterion consecutive-failure counter and its state file, the open-ticket title->unreliable map builder that feeds the selector, both quarantine triggers (three consecutive failures AND not-inline-runnable container/ISF), idempotent unreliable-criterion ticket creation, and the per-run ledger budget stop.
Expose the loop as a directly invocable command handler so an operator, a cron or any CI provider can drive it.
Register the loop command's argparse subparser and its interval/options flags.
Add the loop's interval setting, defaulting to 30 days.

Unit tests for gap-only selection, the three-strike breaker and its exact ticket title, the container/ISF immediate quarantine, idempotent creation, the skip on an open ticket, the per-run ledger stop and the due-stamp interval.
Register the fixture_heal config keys / REBAR_FIXTURE_HEAL_INTERVAL_DAYS env var and any new mechanisms so the mechanism-delta ratchet passes.
Document the new criteria heal subcommand (scheduled fixture-heal sweep).
Add help text for the criteria heal subcommand.
Register the fixture_heal config section for py3.11 config-parity.
Config accessor for the fixture_heal section / interval.
Export the heal_fixtures / HealReport public surface.
Reuse the spend ledger (ledger.reserve) for the per-sweep budget cap enforcement.
Regenerated config-surface golden including fixture_heal keys.
Held-out edge/E2E oracle for the heal sweep (quarantine, budget stop, idempotency, due-stamp, CLI observability).
